known_secrets.text: The Song is not sung exactly as written. Each generation alters it slightly.
Nara has noticed old records showing differences in the Song over time.
She fears the original version may already be lost.
A recurring line in the Song can be translated approximately as: 'Do not climb.' She has never told anyone.
She sometimes wonders whether the founders were warning future generations rather than blessing them.
Neither realizes the two are connected
Both believe they are protecting the settlement
